candidate_guard.statement: This artifact proposes literary units only and neither creates nor authorizes an official Luke map.

routing_principle: Prefer complete scenes, paired panels, songs with narrative frames, controversy exchanges, parable applications, meal frames, journey episodes, discourse movements, trials, and passion/appearance episodes. Journey notices and rapid conjunctions mark flow but do not independently atomize verses.

Galilean teaching, healing, call, and controversy cycles
Healings, John response, meal, and women summary
Parables, sea crossing, deliverance, and Jairus-woman cycle
Mission, feeding, recognition, prediction, transformation, and healing

Passion: preparation, meal, farewell, prayer, arrest, hearings, death, and burial

journey_subparents.label: Journey turn, mission, lawyer, household, and prayer

over_split_premortem: Do not atomize paired annunciation, birth, song, or presentation panels; preserve each narrative-speech frame and paired parent.
Do not treat the 9:51 journey notice, subsequent travel notices, chapter numbers, or rapid conjunctions as automatic unit boundaries.
Do not sever a parable from its initiating question, audience frame, interpretation, or application.
Do not fragment meal teaching into isolated sayings when one host, table, objection, or response governs the scene.
Do not split lists, genealogies, songs, beatitude/woe pairs, warnings, accusations, appearance proofs, or variant-dependent clauses into verse atoms.
Do not separate passion preparation, meal, farewell, prayer, arrest, denial, hearing, death, burial, tomb, road recognition, Jerusalem appearance, or departure from its immediate closure.
